correctness.rationale: Exact exhaustive dual face predicates agree on all 65536 masks; 45706 faces and 329552 Hasse covers reconstructed. Two staged pairings each match 22847 disjoint covering pairs and leave one 0-cell, ten 7-cells, and one 9-cell. Each complete oriented Hasse DAG is independently topologically sorted; no cycle remains. The discrete-Morse CW chain complex has no degree-8 or degree-6 groups, hence zero cellular boundaries and precisely Z^10 in degree 7 and Z in degree 9; six-connectivity follows from absence of cells in degrees 1..6. The 9-cell homotopy attaching map is NOT determined. The packaged verifier and recorded output exactly reproduce these quantities.

originality.rationale: Statements, object definitions and implications from the full text of arXiv:0705.1461, arXiv:1501.06754, arXiv:2312.02639, and four same-graph or adjacent published result files were compared. Forest/chordal scope excludes this cube; Alexander duality alone does not evaluate the needed complement-graph neighborhood complex. Independence, original-graph Lovasz neighborhood, total-cut, and bounded-domination graph complexes have distinctly defined face universes. No observed covering statement; publication priority remains subject to unindexed equivalent literature.
residual_risks: Unindexed or older equivalent presentation under a different name may exist.

value.rationale: Canonical four-dimensional hypercube Q4 is a natural periodic 4-by-4 grid; its fixed-graph dominance complex encodes dominating-set complements. The verifier checks dimensions 1,2,3 with reduced homology concentrated in a single degree, while Q4 has exact torsion-free reduced integral homology in two separated degrees, a motivated sharp small-dimension topology transition. Full integral ranks, six-connectivity and explicit potential unstable attaching problem materially exceed routine Euler or domination-number counts. No all-parameter theorem is required for this natural complete finite classification.
